data.one_liner: Geohash encoding, decoding, neighbors, and distance helpers for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities to encode and decode locations to and from geohashes, find neighboring cells, calculate distances, and query Cloud Firestore databases by radius using string range queries.
use_when: You need to query location-based data within a radius in Cloud Firestore.
You want to encode and decode geohashes compatible with Firebase's geofire-common.
You need a pure Dart solution that works across all platforms including the web.
avoid_when: You require complex spatial queries that only a native database backend can provide.
You need an entire out-of-the-box maps UI component instead of raw geolocation math.
strengths: Compatible with Firebase geofire-common for cross-platform web and mobile queries.
Pure Dart implementation with no dependencies, running on all platforms.
No class name collisions with cloud_firestore or popular map packages.
weaknesses: Geohash range queries can produce false positives that must be filtered out manually by distance.
Query performance degrades for very large radii or near polar regions.
